target.title: Expose legacy plugin dependency doctor lint findings
target.body:
## Summary
- expose stale legacy plugin dependency state roots as default-disabled `core/doctor/legacy-plugin-dependencies` lint findings
- reuse the existing safe cleanup target preparation so lint reports only roots already considered removable by the legacy `doctor --fix` cleanup path
- keep all real deletion in the existing repair sequence; selected lint is read-only

## Contract / compatibility
- No public SDK, plugin manifest, config schema, persisted data-model, or plugin contract changes.
- Default `doctor --lint` behavior is unchanged because the check is `defaultEnabled: false`; `--only core/doctor/legacy-plugin-dependencies` and `--all` can select it.
- `doctor --fix` remains the mutation owner for removing legacy plugin dependency state.

## Validation
- `./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check src/commands/doctor/shared/plugin-dependency-cleanup.ts src/commands/doctor/shared/plugin-dependency-cleanup.test.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.test.ts`
- `./node_modules/.bin/oxlint src/commands/doctor/shared/plugin-dependency-cleanup.ts src/commands/doctor/shared/plugin-dependency-cleanup.test.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.test.ts`
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/commands/doctor/shared/plugin-dependency-cleanup.test.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.test.ts`
- `node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.core.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/core.tsbuildinfo`
- `node scripts/plugin-sdk-surface-report.mjs --check`
- `node scripts/sync-plugin-sdk-exports.mjs --check`
- `git diff --check`

## Real behavior proof

Behavior or issue addressed:
Legacy plugin dependency state such as `$OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR/plugin-runtime-deps` can now be surfaced as a structured Doctor lint warning when explicitly selected, without deleting the state from lint.

Real environment tested:
WSL Ubuntu 24.04 source checkout at this PR head, hydrated with `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`; source CLI using isolated `HOME`, `OPENCLAW_HOME`, `OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR`, and `OPENCLAW_CONFIG_PATH`. No Gateway, plugin runtime, or live service was required.

Exact steps or command run after this patch:
1. Created an isolated temp state root containing `state/plugin-runtime-deps` and an empty config file.
2. Ran `timeout 30s node --import tsx src/entry.ts doctor --lint --json --only core/doctor/legacy-plugin-dependencies` with the isolated environment.
3. Parsed the JSON output and verified the legacy root still existed after lint completed.

Evidence after fix:
```json
{
  "ok": false,
  "checksRun": 1,
  "checksSkipped": 36,
  "findings": [
    {
      "checkId": "core/doctor/legacy-plugin-dependencies",
      "severity": "warning",
      "message": "Legacy plugin dependency state remains at /tmp/tmp.b8E671suj1/state/plugin-runtime-deps.",
      "path": "/tmp/tmp.b8E671suj1/state/plugin-runtime-deps",
      "target": "/tmp/tmp.b8E671suj1/state/plugin-runtime-deps",
      "requirement": "legacy-plugin-dependency-state-removed",
      "fixHint": "Run `openclaw doctor --fix` to remove legacy plugin dependency state."
    }
  ]
}
```

Additional source-harness proof from `src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.test.ts` verifies default lint skips this default-disabled check, `--only core/doctor/legacy-plugin-dependencies` runs it, and the legacy dependency root remains present afterward.

Observed result after fix:
Selected lint ran exactly one check, emitted one warning for the stale legacy dependency root, exited non-zero because a warning was present, and did not remove the root. Default-lint selection is covered by the focused regression and remains skipped.

What was not tested:
No live package install/update or Gateway service path was tested; this slice only exposes read-only lint for state already handled by the existing `doctor --fix` cleanup path.


### Dry-run repair preview update - 2026-07-02

Added structured repair support for the legacy plugin dependency lint finding so `doctor fix --dry-run --only core/doctor/legacy-plugin-dependencies` reports state/file effects without removing legacy dependency roots. When stale global plugin-runtime symlinks point into the selected legacy roots, the preview reports those symlink removals before the state-root removal.

Proof on rebased head `e796ee3cc6`:
- `./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check src/commands/doctor/shared/plugin-dependency-cleanup.ts src/commands/doctor/shared/plugin-dependency-cleanup.test.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.test.ts`
- `./node_modules/.bin/oxlint src/commands/doctor/shared/plugin-dependency-cleanup.ts src/commands/doctor/shared/plugin-dependency-cleanup.test.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.test.ts`
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/commands/doctor/shared/plugin-dependency-cleanup.test.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.test.ts`
- `node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.core.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/core.tsbuildinfo`
- `node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p test/tsconfig/tsconfig.core.test.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/core-test.tsbuildinfo`
